response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 20 days ago. The electronics-specific rules (priority 20) dominate the standard 30-day window (priority 10). Since days_since_delivery (20) > 15, RET-003 applies and returns are not accepted. Higher-priority rules do not apply: item is not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051).
